Simple_HGN.architecture: 2 hidden stages +1 class output =3 convolutions; heads[8,8,1]; hidden64 per head; edge embedding64; alpha0.05 residual attention between hidden stages; detached previous attention at conv:141; residual feature maps on hidden/output; biased type input fc; message/edge/residual projections biasFalse, conv output biasFalse; ELU/slope0.05; feature/attention dropout0.5; native final L2-normalized class logits retained
Simple_HGN.graph: Undirected union plus one self loop per node. edge2type assigns raw released direction first, synthetic self=number of raw types, synthetic reverse only if reverse pair absent. Endpoint-only dictionary can collapse multiple relation labels on the same ordered edge; audit actual archive multiplicities before runtime qualification.

SeHGNN.features: All available attributes; missing node attributes replaced with dense identity in load_dataset. CPU native mean feature propagation for DBLP/ACM before model training; per-metapath learned dense projection in forward, not a fully parameter-free classifier.
SeHGNN.DBLP_graph: A/P/T/V schema, six relation directions; native feature propagation2hops and label propagation4hops
SeHGNN.ACM_graph: Released PP and PP_r both loaded then union/coalesce/set_diag; native omits field/K nodes (ACM_keep_F=False) because raw features encode field distribution. Retains citation/reference information under its native merged P-P channel. This is declared author preprocessing, not a common graph encoding across arms.
SeHGNN.label_inputs: Only TRAIN one-hot labels seeded at main:211-212. Row-normalized metapath adjacency products; remove_diag(full metapath adjacency) @ label_onehot at306 removes self-label contribution. No VAL/TEST labels used as propagated inputs by inspected code.
SeHGNN.architecture: Per-metapath embedding matrix;2 per-metapath biased maps with LayerNorm/PReLU/dropout; transformer num_heads1 by default, Q/K hidden/4 and V hidden; gamma0 attention residual; concat fc; DBLP residual true, task depth3; ACM residual false/task depth1. Task head includes BatchNorm with class affineFalse and track_running_statsFalse: evaluation depends on fixed batch composition.
SeHGNN.training: Adam lr1e-3 wd0; batch-size10000;200 maxepochs; patience50; criterion CE; best validation loss checkpoint; AMP/GradScaler requested by native command. Same paired study seeds can replace author demo seed list only after parent binding.
